name: Find Records
description: Retrieves selected fields for some or all records of a selected object. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/dome_get_field_values.htm)

configurable_props.name: sobjectType
configurable_props.label: SObject Type
configurable_props.description: The type of object to obtain records of.

configurable_props.name: fieldsToObtain
configurable_props.label: Fields to Obtain
configurable_props.description: Select the field(s) to obtain for the selected record(s) (or all records).

configurable_props.name: recordIds
configurable_props.label: Record ID(s)
configurable_props.description: The record(s) to retrieve. If not specified, all records will be retrieved.
